articles.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Genco Shipping Trading Limited (NYSE: GNK) announced today that it will hold a conference call to discuss the Company’s results for the third quarter of 2026 on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time.
